text:
maria: Heads-up — Nvidia partner ops flagged a potential microcode/factory firmware delay for a subset of H200/B200 SKUs. Could impact our GA timeline if carriers hit the same batch. They asked about our marketplace embargo flexibility and telemetry contract terms.

henry: What's the ETA on the affected batches? Any vendor-provided mitigation (hotfix image) or kernel shim?

maria: They said 2-3 week slip for ~15% of H200 units if current firmware is required. They proposed a staged firmware push but asked us to sign off on allowing an 'embargo exception' for partners to pre-stage images.

olivia: From infra perspective, pre-staging images into our lab is fine if we lock keys and restrict to canaries. We'll need E2E telemetry hooks turned on so we can detect regressions. Also need a rollback playbook.

raj: For contract/KPIs: vendor is offering a partial credit (clawback) if delivery SLA misses >10%. We should not accept unilateral embargo exceptions without MSP/partner-ops sign-off.

susan: Marketing asks: if we allow exception, is there a PR/embargo risk? We need a comms window and an embargo-handshake with vendor and integrators.

maria: Proposal: 1) Accept staged pre-staging for canaries only (10% traffic), 2) require vendor telemetry endpoint + syslogs, 3) add clause to marketplace listing noting 'firmware update pending'—so we can keep listings live. Thoughts?

henry: +1 for canaries. Add automated health checks: latency threshold, error-rate alert. Sample check snippet:

```
check: model_infer_ok
thresholds:
  p95_latency_ms: 600
  error_rate_pct: 1.0
```

olivia: We'll need an onboarding checklist for the SI integrators: signed NDA for images, telemetry access, test prompt set, rollback triggers.

raj: Legal wants the clawback language in writing before we enable pre-staging. I'll loop in contracts. Also ask vendor for a nightly build signature so we can verify images.

maria: Action items:
- raj: get written clawback + signature process by next Tue
- olivia/henry: draft canary rollout config and health checks
- susan: draft comms embargo window and partner messaging
- maria: schedule call with vendor & 2 SI leads

If anyone objects to the staged exception speak now. Otherwise I'll proceed.

henry: No objections from infra. Add a metric to Platform Console to surface per-SKU microcode version.

susan: I'll prep press freeze language. prefer a 48h final signoff window.

embargo-bot: Reminder: schedule created - vendor-call-wed-10am PT (auto-created).
